copy.title: Adjustable Dog Car Seat Belt, Polyester and Zinc Alloy
bullets: Adjustable, stretchy length for a range of dog sizes
Length adjusts from a 70 cm minimum to a 125 cm maximum stretch
Polyester and zinc alloy construction for car rides
Available in black or dark grey
One pet car seat belt included in each order
copy.description: If your dog rides along in the car, you want a belt that adjusts to fit. This elastic, adjustable pet seat belt adjusts for a range of dog sizes. It adjusts from a minimum size of 70 cm and can stretch to a maximum length of 125 cm. The belt is made of polyester and zinc alloy and has a listed net weight of about 185 g. Each order includes one pet car seat belt. Each belt ships in a plastic bag. Pet parents who want a simple, adjustable option for everyday car rides will find this belt a practical choice. The adjustable length helps you set the fit. If you travel with more than one dog, you can order a second belt. Ask yourself how often you drive with your dog, and pick a belt that suits your routine. Check the shipping estimate before you order.

faq.q: How do I know if it fits my dog?
faq.a: The belt has a minimum size of 70 cm and can stretch to 125 cm. Compare these lengths with your car and your dog before you order.

faq.q: What is the belt made of?
faq.a: It is made of polyester and zinc alloy, and has a listed net weight of about 185 g.
Estimate: 5–11 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from China. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.

copy.safety_warning: Attach only to a harness, never a collar. This belt is not designed as a crash restraint. Supervise your dog in the car.
copy.shipping_estimate: Estimate: 5–11 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from China.
